summary: Configuration launch-matrix and native idle tests passed: missing, valid, legacy, malformed, and active-profile startup paths remain read-only until an explicit action.
Planner and coordinator tests passed for deterministic ordered previews, zero preview mutations, exact backup paths, and Apply reuse of the previewed immutable plan.

Planner and transaction tests passed for missing sources, canonical-home escapes, unsafe parent links/files, recursive mappings, protected app storage, destination conflicts, stale plans, and commit-boundary races.
Transaction tests passed for exact regular-file, directory, valid-link, and broken-link backups; unique adjacent paths; staged mutations; and atomically persisted journal transitions.
Successful-apply, serialization, and UI tests passed: one explicit operation commits once, records completion, suppresses self-feedback, and updates the active profile only after commit.
Fault injection at reversible boundaries, crash recovery, rollback-race, and native recovery tests passed; rollback is reverse ordered and unresolved user-owned state is preserved for retry.
Undo tests passed for exact restoration, removal of transaction-owned creations only, active-profile restoration, repeated no-op behavior, and refusal after destination or backup tampering.
Coordinator tests passed for FIFO serialization, non-overlap, queued cancellation, recovery blocking, deterministic state, and structured asynchronous operation without polling.
Legacy migration tests passed for read-only detection, explicit staging, destination conflict refusal, source preservation, partial-destination cleanup, and journaled finalization warnings.

Configuration compatibility tests passed for defaults, unknown fields, malformed-byte preservation, actionable invalid state, backed atomic saves, optimistic locking, and concurrent-create/change races.

JSON/YAML compatibility and profile-validation tests passed for older defaults and supported wallpaper, editor, replacement, link, extension, and startup-script plan behavior; invalid profiles remain visible.

Model lifecycle and native reload tests passed, and source review confirmed metadata-only reload, one shared ApplicationModel, watcher teardown, and hotkey clear/re-register without duplicate handlers.
The 1,000-file coordinator fixture passed with a progressing main-actor heartbeat and no operation overlap; source review found no Thread.sleep, busy-wait, or unstructured Apply path.
All 3 real-process XCUITests passed for Preview, applying, success, invalid-profile failure, recovery-required, and Undo controls and messages.
Decision D-005 approves real native XCUITest as the browser-equivalent for this AppKit/SwiftUI menu-bar app; the suite drove the shipped process through the visible release states.
The exact-head success state shows the active profile only after completion and exposes Undo.
The exact-head recovery state presents an actionable Restore Previous State control without claiming success.
Accessibility-identifier and keyboard interaction assertions passed in the real application for all tested controls and alerts.
The approved native browser-equivalent XCUITest interacted with the real Settings window and AppKit alerts through macOS accessibility APIs.
Exact-head native idle state.
Exact-head immutable Preview state.
Exact-head applying state with operation text and mutation controls disabled.
Exact-head successful Apply state.
Exact-head invalid-profile failure state.
Exact-head recovery-required state.
Exact-head completed Undo state.

Exact head aef08e9 passed CI run 30784824071: XcodeGen drift, Debug build/analyze, 38 unit tests, 3 UI tests, Release build/analyze, macOS 14 metadata, and universal arm64/x86_64 archive verification.

EXPECTED_TAG=v1.2.0 scripts/verify-version.sh and exact-head CI passed with project.yml canonical version 1.2.0, monotonically increased build 120, generated plist, About metadata, and archive metadata aligned; publication remains intentionally untagged until credentials exist.

Release-script syntax and independent workflow review passed: credential preflight, exact archived app identity, Developer ID verification, hardened-runtime/entitlement checks, notarization wait, stapling, and Gatekeeper assessment all fail closed before publication.

Independent release-workflow review passed: the cask update follows immutable asset creation and SHA-256 computation, then enforces version/URL/minimum macOS, brew audit/fetch/install/launch/reinstall, configuration-sentinel preservation, and idempotent tap commits.

README and v1.2.0 release-note claim review passed against source and tests for Preview, adjacent backups, Undo, explicit migration, recovery, macOS 14+, and supported integrations, without claims for stubbed Terminal.app, iTerm2, or system-theme features.
